sideA.text:
It's time to start listening...

The Frequency Scanner is on the other side of this card. You'll use this card whenever you do the Monitor action.

Keep this card in the reserve between games.

sideB.text:
When you do the Monitor action, scratch a box, then refer to the text below.

IF YOU REVEAL:
An orange square: Open the dossier door.
A white square: Take 1 or 2 cards from the top of the Player discard pile and add them to your hand. (You may not take Epidemic cards.)

Ten boxes, bottom (low) to top (high): 8.24, 8.81, 9.1, 9.2, 9.31, 9.58, 9.75, 10.31, 10.57, 11.88.

mechanics.whenRead: Continue the August setup Legacy-deck reading, immediately after 08-03. Read side A, then keep the card. Use side B from then on whenever a player does the Monitor action.
triggers: Monitor action: scratch one unscratched frequency box, then apply the legend.
opensDoors: 52, if the 9.2 box is the one scratched
43, if the 11.88 box is the one scratched
addsToPool: Frequency Scanner (this card), kept in the reserve between games
rules: Keep this card in the reserve between games.
Whenever you do the Monitor action, scratch one box on side B, then apply the legend.
An orange numbered sticker means open that dossier door.
A white square means take 1 or 2 cards from the top of the Player discard pile and add them to your hand. You may not take Epidemic cards.
8.24 (state 2, bottom): white square, take 1 or 2 non-Epidemic cards from the Player discard.
8.81 (state 3): white square, take 1 or 2 non-Epidemic cards from the Player discard.
9.1 (state 4): white square, take 1 or 2 non-Epidemic cards from the Player discard.
9.31 (state 6): white square, take 1 or 2 non-Epidemic cards from the Player discard.
9.58 (state 7): white square, take 1 or 2 non-Epidemic cards from the Player discard.
9.75 (state 8): white square, take 1 or 2 non-Epidemic cards from the Player discard.
10.31 (state 9): white square, take 1 or 2 non-Epidemic cards from the Player discard.
10.57 (state 10): white square, take 1 or 2 non-Epidemic cards from the Player discard.
mechanics.notes: The ten boxes are a vertical column. 8.24 is the bottom box and 11.88 is the top box. Each state photo scratches exactly one box and leaves the other nine covered, in order from 8.24 (state 2) through 11.88 (state 11). Side A of every state is the same Frequency Scanner intro. Only 9.2 and 11.88 are doors (52 and 43). The other eight boxes are the white discard-pile icon.
